nodes.label: Solfège Trainer Application
nodes.rationale: Web app for solfège homework: sheet-music image and/or audio + text description; two roles (manager, student); target browsers Chrome 117+ and Safari 17+ only

nodes.label: Manager Role
nodes.rationale: Manager manages exercises (add/edit/delete/reorder), manages users (create, reset password, deactivate), reads listening journal; product-facing term is 'manager', not 'admin' or 'teacher'

nodes.label: Student Role
nodes.rationale: Student can only listen to exercises (sequential or random) and change own settings; cannot access manager pages; product-facing term is 'student', not 'pupil' or 'child'

nodes.label: Exercise Model
nodes.rationale: Exercise = id, title, description, category (optional), position, image (optional), audio (optional), score (optional from OMR), deleted_at (soft delete); at least one of image or audio required; soft delete only so journal survives deletion

nodes.label: OMR Pipeline (Audiveris)
nodes.rationale: Audiveris selected after evaluating 10 real exercise images; 8/10 meet threshold; async job queue (Postgres SKIP LOCKED); OmrEngine interface allows engine replacement; manager must approve before students see score; original image always kept as fallback

nodes.label: Spoken Notes Feature
nodes.rationale: Notes are spoken (not sung); pre-generated syllable clips via OpenAI TTS committed to frontend/public/solfege/<lang>/<naming>/; Web Audio API playback; preferred tempo 72 BPM; auto-reduce tempo when short notes require more speech time; available only when score approved

nodes.label: Telegram Audio Import
nodes.rationale: Owner replaced PWA audio sharing with Telegram bot on 2026-09-29 after Android PWA share delivered empty form; real Telegram receipt and playback of 199163078.m4a confirmed; manager-only import; reuses PHASE 2 file pipeline

nodes.label: Emergency Manager
nodes.rationale: On every backend start: if EMERGENCY_MANAGER_* env vars set, create/update user (role=manager, active, password reset); if not set, deactivate user with is_emergency=true; first-user mechanism AND disaster-recovery mechanism; emergency sync completes before backend startup succeeds

nodes.label: Material Design Migration (MUI v9)
nodes.rationale: Separate feature after PHASE 7 acceptance; Material UI v9, Emotion, self-hosted Roboto, Community DataGrid v9; no Date Pickers (requires unapproved dependency); native dates, audio, tempo, score rendering unchanged; owner authorizes all remaining steps together on 2026-10-01

nodes.label: Authentication and Session Management
nodes.rationale: scrypt with N=32768, r=8, p=3; 256-bit random session tokens; PostgreSQL stores only SHA-256 hashes; httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies; 90-day sliding lifetime; login rate limit per username+IP; CSRF via session-bound tokens in X-CSRF-Token header (except sendBeacon which uses JSON body)

nodes.label: Postgres Job Queue (SKIP LOCKED)
nodes.rationale: Postgres-based job queue using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; no Redis to reduce service count; job has status, attempts, last_error, locked_at; used by OMR worker; workers own separate engines and sessions

nodes.label: Protected File Serving (X-Accel-Redirect)
nodes.rationale: Files never served directly; nginx internal location + X-Accel-Redirect after backend auth check; Range requests required for Safari audio seeking; backend never reads file into memory; X-Accel-Redirect and nginx byte-range delivery confirmed in PHASE 0.5

nodes.label: Pre-commit Hooks
nodes.rationale: Backend: ruff check, ruff format, mypy strict; Frontend: eslint, prettier, tsc; same hooks run in CI; minimum pre-commit version 4.3.0; Node 22.23.3 with npm 12.1.0

nodes.label: Appearance Settings Feature
nodes.rationale: Separate branch feat/appearance-settings from c4ee4f1; independent light/dark schemes per account (classic, forest, warm, plum); fonts (Roboto, system, serif); base sizes (16, 18, 20px); live example panel before save; browser-local light/dark mode; migration 0007_appearance preserves existing accounts

nodes.label: Material UI v9
nodes.rationale: Chosen after PHASE 7 hardening; provides shared blue-gray theme with light and dark schemes; requires Chrome 117+ and Safari 17+; native date controls retained because Date Pickers requires an additional unapproved date library

nodes.label: Scrypt Password Hashing
nodes.rationale: Standard-library scrypt with fixed cost N=32768, r=8, p=3 and a 16-byte random salt; PostgreSQL stores only the SHA-256 hash of each session token

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Listening events carry CSRF token in JSON body rather than header because sendBeacon cannot set custom headers; all other mutations use header-based X-CSRF-Token

nodes.label: Alembic Migration Versions
nodes.rationale: Private production Alembic version schema prevents runtime application role from accessing migration metadata; development uses public schema

nodes.label: Spoken Notes Vocabulary and Clips
nodes.rationale: 66 pre-generated AAC clips served as public static assets; Web Audio clock used for scheduling (not chained timers); playback rate never drops below 1 to preserve natural voice pitch; silence fills remaining duration for short words in long notes

nodes.label: X-Accel-Redirect Protected Delivery
nodes.rationale: FastAPI returns X-Accel-Redirect header; nginx resolves through internal /_protected_media/ location; FastAPI never reads file bytes; Direct external requests to the internal location return 404

nodes.label: Release Bundle Artifact
nodes.rationale: Contains release.json with immutable image digests, deployment Compose files, and SHA-256 hashes; publication only after successful production container checks; 30-day retention

nodes.label: Product Telegram Worker
nodes.rationale: Shares backend image; uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for claiming pending imports; PostgreSQL advisory lock prevents concurrent pollers; deterministic media UUID derived from Telegram update ID prevents duplicate files on retry

nodes.label: Game Player Model
nodes.rationale: FK to users.id; level computed from xp using threshold array in config.py — not stored; maps to student role; supports multiple player profiles per parent account

nodes.label: Game Round Anti-Cheat Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Server generates all 7 tasks upfront; timing validated server-side (issued_at + time_limit + grace_ms); double-tap guard returns already-stored result idempotently for same task_index; tasks one at a time prevents pre-solving

nodes.label: Game Staff SVG Renderer
nodes.rationale: Custom SVG per owner decision (not OpenSheetMusicDisplay); diatonic pitch-to-staff-position mapping; ledger lines only when needed (position < 0 or > 8); responsive via viewBox

nodes.label: AI Avatar Generation Worker
nodes.rationale: Follows OMR worker pattern with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; OpenAI moderation check before DALL-E generation; base+happy+sad variant generation; daily limit via avatar_generation_log; flagged requests not billable

nodes.label: GameTheme Child MUI Theme
nodes.rationale: Child MUI theme wrapping only /game/* routes; does not affect the rest of the app; coral primary, sunflower secondary, mint success palette; Fredoka font (Cyrillic-capable) via @fontsource/fredoka; 24px border radius; pill-shaped buttons with 3D pressed effect

nodes.label: Confusion Analytics
nodes.rationale: Kid-facing: one friendly hint per round based on top confusion; admin-facing: 7x7 heatmap expected x entered, top-3 confusions with counts, filterable by clef; aggregated in SQL with indexes on (season_id, player_id)

nodes.label: Game Web Audio Synthesis
nodes.rationale: No sample files; triangle oscillator with frequency 440*2^((midi-69)/12); 0.3s decay envelope; AudioContext unlocked on first user gesture; fire-and-forget, errors silently swallowed — never blocks input

nodes.label: VPS Rollout Script
nodes.rationale: Stops application services, runs migrations, then starts with healthchecks; compatible rollback checks previous release Alembic heads against current database before restarting; DEPLOY_DISK_INSUFFICIENT blocks before any service changes

nodes.label: PHASE 7 Hardening and Documentation
nodes.rationale: Final accepted phase as of 2026-10-01; includes storage preflight, 404 page, security headers (CSP/HSTS/frame denial), structured logs, dependency audits, and smoke checklist

nodes.rationale: Superseded by Telegram bot on 2026-09-29 after PWA sharing failed on Android with 'No audio file was received'; existing deployment preserved until separate cleanup task

nodes.label: Telegram Audio Prototype Guide (Historical)

nodes.label: Solfeo Telegram Bot (@solfeo_exercises_bot)

nodes.label: Audiveris OMR Engine (v5.11.0)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for optical music recognition; uses Tesseract OCR 5.5.2 on aarch64 Linux; worker retries staff detection once with faint-line threshold; approved scores enable spoken notes; rejected or failed scores show original image to students
